QuestInfo.name: [Dark World Tree] Those Who Remained
QuestInfo.0: Most of the demons returned to Masteria after Damien was defeated by the heroes, but some remained in Maple World to corrupt the World Tree. A man who looks like their leader contacts you.
QuestInfo.1: Most of the demons returned to Masteria after Damien was defeated by the heroes, but some remained in Maple World to corrupt the World Tree. A man who looks like their leader contacts you.
QuestInfo.2: It's just a matter of time until the World Tree is corrupted again if the demons are left unchecked. Take on Alchetto's request and save the World Tree.
